findings.quote: The American Dental Association lists [what to do in dental emergencies](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/dental-emergencies), including a lost crown or a toothache.
findings.why: The specific examples attributed to the ADA page (lost crown, toothache) are not verifiable from the link and no page content was provided to confirm them.
findings.fix: Confirm the page lists these examples or remove the attribution to the specific items.
